settings.headline: Two partners, twenty-six people, one office on Wharf Street
settings.subtitle: Tellmarsh & Penhallow (fictional) has prepared returns and kept books in Merrow Bend since 1987. The firm, its people, clients and figures are fictional; this is a Raytha example site.

settings.headline: How the firm works
settings.body:
Ada Tellmarsh opened the practice in 1987 above a hardware store on Wharf Street. Nadia Penhallow joined in 1998 and became a partner in 2006; Owen Tellmarsh became a partner in 2012, the year Ada retired.

Every return is prepared by one person and reviewed by another, and every business return is signed by a partner. Fees are fixed and quoted before work starts. We do not bill by the phone call or the email.

— Nadia Penhallow, managing partner (fictional)
settings.memo: 14 Wharf Street, Merrow Bend (fictional). Main line (555) 017-4400. Weekdays 8:30 to 5; February to April also Saturdays 9 to 1.
